what_this_is: The D2b adjudication record. It is normative for the checks it adjudicates, and Confluence page 277708859 mirrors it. It reuses D4a's record format (MES-126) and G32 (MCP.Conformance.Adjudications), which holds its rows equal to the bucket-2b view in both directions, with dispositions from the guard's closed set, a build level and a one-line remedy on every extend_to_match and build_test row, and every repository citation holding the bytes it quotes. Harness citations are verified by the control's harness mode against the pinned build.
what_bucket_2b_is: The bucket-2b view holds 15 checks: every client-leg OC check in the declared population that carries no edge in the crosswalk. Bucket 2 means write the test. Every check here was green at the accepted run (each row's oc_status_at_accepted_run), so each row is a COVERAGE gap, not a behaviour gap: the SDK already does what the check requires, and no ET-CC unit says so.

rendering_guard.rule: Bucket 2b's population sentence, here and on its Confluence mirror, is the predicate verbatim. It is never paraphrased as a claim that the check has no test: a check here may be covered by a unit outside ET-CC (covered_elsewhere).

anchor.bytes:
* It **does not render bucket 2b.** The rule that bucket 2b's population sentence is its
  predicate verbatim (*"OC check with no ET-CC member match"*), and never "untested",

rendering_guard.enforced_by: test/conformance/adjudications_test.exs: the section's population_sentence must equal the anchored predicate, and no prose leaf of this record (quoted bytes excepted) may carry the forbidden word, case-insensitively. Shown red on a plant.
rendering_guard.residual: The Confluence mirror is outside the repository, so gate 5 cannot read it. It is checked by hand at write time, and the check is stated in the close-out.

dispositions_added.extend_to_match: An existing ET-CC unit already drives the seam and sends the check's stimulus, but asserts nothing the check requires. The remedy is an added assertion (or added loop cases) in that unit, which would give the crosswalk an edge. The row cites the unit in extend_target (address and bytes). This is not D4b's extend_test: that code presumes an existing edge with an omitted axis, and a bucket-2 check has no edge.
dispositions_added.build_test: No existing unit drives the check's stimulus at any level, so the remedy is a new ET-CC unit.
dispositions_added.build_level: Both codes carry build_level, one of pure_unit, mock_transport, plug or live_http, and a one-line remedy. G32 refuses a row without them (build_level_missing), and an extend_to_match row without an extend_target. It checks shape only: whether the level and the remedy are right is the reviewer's check.
dispositions_added.covered_elsewhere: An optional row field, not a disposition: the non-ET-CC units that cover the check, each with its address and bytes, or an explicit none with the search that found none.
dispositions_added.not_added: accept_unmatched is not added: no row here needs it, and an unused code widens the set with nothing to exercise it (PM ratification, 29444).

echo_statement.statement: The bucket-2b view's rows carry only leg and tag. G32's echo takes shape, verdicts, bucket and the escalation fields, none of which a bucket-2 row has, so every row's echo is {} and echo_drift is VACUOUS for this section: G32 cannot detect a view row changing under an unchanged key (CR K4 on MES-126, 29418).
echo_statement.substitute: Each row carries oc_status_at_accepted_run, a repository citation of the check's name and status lines in docs/conformance/in-scope-2026-07-28.json. G32's citation_drift verifies those bytes, and gate 5 requires each cited status to be SUCCESS and each cited name to equal the last segment of the row's tag.
echo_statement.limit: The substitute guards the adjudication's PREMISE, that every check here was green at the accepted run. It does not guard the view: a view row is leg and tag, and both are segments of the key, so there is nothing left in a row that could change under an unchanged key. General G32 hardening is MES-135's.
